title: SB2547 (2022 Regular): Firearms; criminalize discharge of within limits of or into municipality.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2022/html/SB/2500-2599/SB2547IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text as filed; no passage vote recorded. Quote omits (1)(b) (judge may reduce to misdemeanor), exceptions (2)(c)-(g) and definitions.

operative_text: Section 1 (new section): (1) (a) A person who with criminal negligence discharges a firearm within or into the limits of any municipality is guilty of a felony. Upon conviction, the defendant shall be fined up to One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00) or imprisoned for a term of years not exceeding two (2) years, or both. (2) This section does not apply if the firearm is discharged: (a) As allowed pursuant to Section 97-3-15; (b) On a properly supervised range; (h) More than one (1) mile from any occupied structure; or (i) In self-defense or defense of another person against an animal attack if a reasonable person would believe that deadly physical force against the animal is immediately necessary and reasonable under the circumstances to protect oneself or the other person.
